name: claudetto
description: Tunes Claude Code for coding at the lowest token cost, through its official extension points only: settings, hooks, skills, and an output style. It patches nothing. The tree is a rebuild in progress, and each capability lands with the measurement that decided its values. The one decided default is the compaction path, which stays the built-in compaction of Claude Code until a measured probe result beats it.

decide.title: Second Opinion
decide.description: Use `off` for no decision tool. Use `jev` for Jev, which needs `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` and sends the questions to the TypeSafe API. With `jev` and a key, the tool `mcp__claudetto__decide` is registered and Claude calls it for a decision that is its own. An `AskUserQuestion` dialog always reaches the user either way. The default is `jev` because the key is the switch: without one no tool is registered and nothing leaves the machine.

TYPESAFE_API_KEY.title: TypeSafe API Key
TYPESAFE_API_KEY.description: The key of Jev for the `decide` and `classifier` options.Claude Code keeps it in secure storage, not in a settings file.

CONTEXT7_API_KEY.title: Context7 API Key
CONTEXT7_API_KEY.description: Optional. The key the `docs` skill's `ctx7` CLI sends to Context7 for higher rate limits. Claude Code keeps it in secure storage, and claudetto passes it to the CLI through the env, never through the context.

cheapSummary.title: Cheap Compaction Summary
cheapSummary.description: Use `on` to have claudetto answer a compaction with one bounded call on `claude-haiku-5-5` instead of letting Claude Code summarize on the model the session runs. It is `off` because no measured rows price it yet, and every failure of the call falls back to the compaction of Claude Code.

classifier.title: Own Tool-Call Classifier
classifier.description: Use `haiku` or `sonnet` to have claudetto judge each tool call that reads or changes more than the read-only tools, in place of the auto mode classifier of Claude Code. It asks Jev first when `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` is set, then `claude-haiku-5-5` at `high` or `claude-sonnet-5-5` at `medium`, and every call is paid. A failed or unclear check denies the call. It is `off` because no measured rows price it or compare it with the built-in classifier yet.

subagentCap.title: Subagents at Once
subagentCap.description: The most subagents that run at the same time. Left unset, the cap is the one of the plan of this login, and a login with no plan row has none. A start past the cap is refused.

startCap.title: Subagent Starts per Period
startCap.description: The most subagent starts inside the period of `windowSeconds`. Left unset, it is 12.

windowSeconds.title: Period in Seconds
windowSeconds.description: The length of the period that `startCap`, `callCap`, and `failLimit` count in. Left unset, it is 600.

callCap.title: Tool Calls per Period at Heavy Context
callCap.description: The most tool calls inside the period while the context is heavy. A call past the cap is held. Left unset, it is 20.

heavyTokens.title: Heavy Context in Tokens
heavyTokens.description: The input tokens of the last response from which the context counts as heavy. Left unset, it is 400000.

failLimit.title: Identical Failures Before a Refusal
failLimit.description: How many times the same call fails with the same error before an identical retry is refused. Left unset, it is 3.
